title: Node.js
description: Node.js and TypeScript projects: Node with npm and TypeScript mounted in; npm's registry and GitHub open, everything else closed.

de.title: Node.js
de.description: Node.js- und TypeScript-Projekte: Node mit npm und TypeScript eingehängt; die Registry von npm und GitHub offen, alles andere zu.

notes: Node.js (with npm, npx and the TypeScript compiler tsc) comes with the preset (--toolchain node): from sandbox-ai's signed toolchains, mounted read-only at /opt/toolchains (nothing to install in the sandbox); it comes before the image's own node. Not in the store yet, the start offers to add it (sandbox-ai toolchain add node: a download, its signature and SHA-256 checked) - on a terminal it asks, with --fix it does, the app asks in its window. Its registries are the ones this preset opens.

npm's cache is in the sandbox's HOME (~/.npm), global installs go to ~/.local; a package's install scripts run in the sandbox, under its rules. Another registry (yarn's, your company's): --allow-host NAME on the command line.
A web app to test in a browser: the preset web-frontend (Playwright, a virtual screen).
Pushes: a login during the run (sandbox-ai net allow --git-token-env ...) or the push proxy.
